after.zh: 查询 Q 与键 K 的比较决定权重，值 V 提供被加权汇总的内容。这里使用缩放点积和 Softmax 计算权重；真实视觉模型通常学习 Q、K、V 的特征表示，让各个图块汇总有用的信息。
after.en: Comparisons between query Q and keys K determine the weights; values V provide the information being combined. This experiment uses scaled dot products and Softmax for the weights. Vision models usually learn the Q, K and V representations so each patch can combine useful information.

t.zh: 卷积一次处理局部区域；注意力可以让一个图块汇总来自其他图块的信息。先通过三段实验观察它如何选择信息、如何形成输出。
t.en: A convolution processes a local region at a time; attention lets a patch combine information from other patches. Three experiments show how attention selects information and forms an output.

t.zh: 图中有一个查询 Q、两个键 K 和对应的值 V。Q 与两个 K 分别比较，得到两个权重；这两个权重用于汇总对应的 V。
t.en: The experiment has one query Q, two keys K and their corresponding values V. Q is compared with both keys to obtain two weights, which are used to combine the corresponding values.

t.zh: 本实验用 4×4 的像素图块直接表示 Q、K 和 V。真实视觉模型通常先将图块变成特征，并用可学习的投影生成 Q、K、V。
t.en: This experiment uses 4×4 pixel patches directly as Q, K and V. Vision models usually first turn patches into features and use learned projections to produce Q, K and V.

brief.zh: 切换查询 Q，比较两个键的权重怎样变化。然后将 Q 设为 O，选择权重较大的键。
brief.en: Switch query Q and compare how the weights of the two keys change. Then set Q to O and select the key with the greater weight.

hint.zh: 键 A 是 X，键 B 是 O。查询与每个键分别比较，匹配程度影响对应的权重。
hint.en: Key A is X and key B is O. The query is compared with each key; the match affects the corresponding weight.

status.en: Adjust the patches and select an answer.

after.zh: Q 是当前图块用于寻找相关信息的表示。改变 Q，即使候选键不变，分配给各个值的权重也会变化。
after.en: Q represents the current patch when finding relevant information. Changing Q can change the weights assigned to the values even when the candidate keys stay fixed.

brief.zh: 查询 Q 固定为 X。交换键 A、B，观察权重如何变化，选择交换后权重较大的键。值的位置保持不变。
brief.en: Query Q is fixed as X. Swap keys A and B, observe the weights, and select the key with the greater weight after the swap. The values stay in place.

hint.zh: 键用于与查询比较；每个键的权重会分配给同一位置的值。
hint.en: Keys are compared with the query; each key’s weight is assigned to the value in the same position.

status.en: Adjust the patches and select an answer.

after.zh: K 是候选信息用于匹配的表示。改变 K 会改变分数和权重，也会改变对应位置的 V 对输出的贡献。
after.en: K represents candidate information for matching. Changing K changes the scores and weights, and therefore the contribution of the V at the corresponding position.

brief.zh: 查询和键保持不变。交换值 A、B，观察权重和输出图块，选择输出中更明显的图案。
brief.en: Keep the query and keys fixed. Swap values A and B, observe the weights and output patch, and select the more prominent pattern in the output.

hint.zh: 权重由 Q 和 K 决定；输出的每个像素是两个值在对应位置的加权和。
hint.en: Q and K determine the weights; each output pixel is the weighted sum of the corresponding pixels in the two values.

status.en: Adjust the patches and select an answer.
